fixes.problem: Durable WAITING/DETACHED process records could be reconstructed as active scheduler slots without proving their managed Chrome window/tab still existed.
fixes.invariant: A durable process may survive detachment; a profile-global scheduler lease requires an exact live managed window/tab surface.

fixes.problem: A hidden trusted conceptual turn could terminalize a renderer lifecycle fragment before the final assistant response/A2A control became observable.
fixes.invariant: Turn ownership does not imply semantic completion; assistant lifecycle/presentation chrome is not final response text.

fixes.problem: The scheduler adoption API did not mechanically distinguish reconciliation of an already-observed prompt effect from ordinary capacity admission.
fixes.invariant: adoptGlobalTurnSlot is callable only with observedEffect=true; new effects still use requestGlobalTurnSlot.

preservedContracts: non-preemptive truth for already-observed in-flight effects
